instructions.instruction: Validate against CHECKLIST.md: a checklist item **passes** when the docs contain a corresponding section with at least one copyable code example or explicit prose statement. A checklist item **fails** when the section is absent, incomplete, or lacks a concrete example. For each failing item: add the missing section or example, then re-run the checklist from the top. Do not finalize until all critical items pass.
